errors.text_span: 切片按顺时针方向从最大占比的“行为”开始排列
errors.evidence: The description states that the slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, but they are arranged counter-clockwise. Starting from the largest slice "行为" (behavior), the next slices in order are "状态" (state), "属性" (attribute), and "要素" (element), which follows a counter-clockwise path.
